purpose: Gold examples for validating extraction of operational events from authoritative collective-agreement publications. These examples are intentionally event-centric rather than summary-centric.

examples.agreementName: Convenio colectivo general de trabajo de la industria textil y de la confección 2024-2026
requiredActions: Apply a 3.3% salary-table increase with effect from 2026-01-01 to companies covered by the agreement.
Pay the agreed increases before 2026-04-30 unless an applicable salary-increase opt-out/inaplicacion has been requested and agreed or approved.
Flag late payment after 2026-04-30 as carrying a stated 10% late-payment surcharge/mora risk, subject to professional review.
evidence: BOE states that the 2025 salary tables are increased by 3.3% with effects from 2026-01-01.

BOE states that affected companies must make the increases effective before 2026-04-30 and that later payment accrues a stated 10% mora surcharge, with the stated exception for approved/agreed inaplicacion.
examples.reviewNotes: High-value example because publication occurs after the effective date and contains both a retroactive payroll consequence and an explicit operational deadline.

examples.agreementName: X Convenio colectivo de Ilunion Outsourcing, SA
requiredActions: Update 2026 salary tables for the affected functional levels according to the published annex.
Review payroll from 2026-01-01 because the published update applies to the period beginning on that date.
Preserve the causal trigger: the update is linked to the 2026 SMI and the agreement's salary-guarantee clause, not a generic annual uplift.
evidence: BOE states that the 2026 SMI has effects from 2026-01-01 and updates the agreement salary tables for 2026 under the salary-guarantee clause.
BOE states a final salary-review percentage of 3.13% for the cited functional levels.
examples.reviewNotes: Important counterexample to simplistic percentage extraction: the operative change is triggered by an SMI-linked guarantee clause and affects specified levels, so the system must capture scope and trigger.

evaluationRules.agreementCodeRule: Never invent a code. Null is preferable when the authoritative text used by the extractor does not expose one.
evaluationRules.deadlineRule: Distinguish explicit legal/contractual payment deadlines from inferred operational recommendations.
evaluationRules.retroactivityRule: Mark retroactive=true when publication occurs after the stated effective date and payroll/financial effects apply from that earlier date.
evaluationRules.actionRule: Actions must be traceable to source facts and phrased for professional review; do not convert extracted text into autonomous payroll execution.
